title: Get fields of an Instant Form or direct message leads
content_data:
Use this endpoint to retrieve the fields of an Instant Form or direct message leads. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/lead/field/get/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | | lead_source {Required}| string | The source of the leads.

Enum values:
  • `INSTANT_FORM`: leads generated through an Instant Form.
  • `DIRECT_MESSAGE`: leads generated from direct messages of the associated Business Account.
| | advertiser_id {+Conditional} | string | Required when the leads are under an ad account.

Advertiser ID. | | library_id {+Conditional} | string | Required when the leads are under a form library of a Business Center.

ID of a form library.

To obtain the list of form libraries within a Business Center, use [/page/library/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1740029915327489). | | page_id {+Conditional} | string |
  • Required when `lead_source` is `INSTANT_FORM`.
  • Not supported when `lead_source` is `DIRECT_MESSAGE`.

The page ID of an Instant Form.

To obtain a list of Instant Forms, use [/page/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1820826387779586) and set `business_type` to `LEAD_GEN`. | ``` ### Example #### Get fields of an Instant From ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/lead/field/get/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&lead_source=INSTANT_FORM&page_id={{page_id}}' \ --header 'Access-token: {{Access-token}}' (/code) ``` #### Get fields of direct message leads ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/lead/field/get/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&lead_source=DIRECT_MESSAGE' \ --header 'Access-token: {{Access-token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #| fields | string[] | The fields of the Instant Form or direct message leads.

Note: The data within this string array depends on the questions that you have set in the Instant Form or the questions collected in the direct message leads. | #| meta_data | object | Metadata about the Instant Form or direct message leads. | ##| create_time | string | The time when the Instant Form was created or when the direct message lead was collected, in the format of `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (UTC+0 time).

Example: `2025-01-01 00:00:01`. | ##| page_id | string | The page ID of the Instant Form.

When `lead_source` is `DIRECT_MESSAGE` in the request, this field will be `"0"`. | ##| page_name | string | The page name of the Instant Form.

When `lead_source` is `DIRECT_MESSAGE` in the request, this field will be an empty string (`""`). | ##| page_url | string | The URL of the Instant Form.

When `lead_source` is `DIRECT_MESSAGE` in the request, this field will be an empty string (`""`). | ``` ### Example #### Get fields of an Instant From ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "fields": [ "email" ], "meta_data": { "create_time": "{{create_time}}", "page_id": "{{page_id}}", "page_name": "{{page_name}}", "page_url": "{{page_url}}" } } } (/code) ``` #### Get fields of direct message leads ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "fields": [ "name", "tiktok", "email", "phone_number" ], "meta_data": { "create_time": "{{create_time}}", "page_id": "0", "page_name": "", "page_url": "" } } } (/code) ```
